title: Faces in the Tangle
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 21 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Faces found in a tangle. The works in this room are drawn as dense, many-colored scribble, and the face comes out of it: a person with glasses, a man in a hat, a girl in a cap, a screaming head in a halo of white. Twenty-one works, from the second drawing in the series on October 27, 2021, to April 2022.

The scribble is not fill. It is the drawing. Hair, cheeks, beards and backgrounds are all the same looping line in different colors, and the features are the places where the line gets dense or changes color. Glasses are two loops. A mouth is a red knot with white inside it.

Watch how the tangle thins. In the first weeks the whole square is scribble. In February two faces are painted with the tangle only on top. By March the scribble has become hatching, and the faces snarl.

chapters.title: Likenesses in Scribble
chapters.opening: Five works from October 27 to November 27, 2021. People with glasses and hats, and a face lost in magenta.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #2
works.text: A face with rectangular glasses and a fanged grin, drawn entirely in scribble: yellow and red for the hair, green and blue for the cheeks, a red knot for the mouth with white teeth inside it. The glasses are two white loops joined by a bar. The second work in the series, from October 27, 2021. Where the first was a box, this is a person, and the way the line finds a likeness is the method of the whole room.
works.caption: A face with rectangular glasses and a fanged grin drawn entirely in yellow, red, green and blue scribble.
works.reading: The grin is a wide red shape with a row of white triangles, drawn in loops that overlap. The hair is yellow and red scribble with black over it. The ground is scribble too, in lilac and green, so the face has no edge. Recorded with 329 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #4
works.text: A face with round purple glasses and a small red mouth, its hair yellow and blue scribble, drawn in loops of every color on a pale ground.
works.caption: A face with round purple glasses and a small red mouth, hair in yellow and blue scribble.
works.reading: The glasses are two purple circles drawn several times, with small eyes inside. The mouth is a red oval with white teeth. The shirt at the bottom is a few black lines. Recorded with 376 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #5
works.text: A face in a storm of magenta line. Twenty-eight strokes make the whole drawing, but each stroke is long, looping across the square again and again, and the face is found where the line turns blue and green: two eyes, a nose, a closed mouth. The face does not stand out from the tangle. It is the tangle, looked at long enough.
works.caption: A face found in a storm of looping magenta line, its features where the line turns blue and green.
works.reading: With 28 strokes and nearly 55,000 recorded points, each stroke runs for a very long time without lifting. The eyes are two dark loops with white in them. The mouth is a short horizontal knot. Recorded on November 4, 2021.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #7
works.text: A head on red with two square goggle eyes, a big grin of pointed white teeth, two ears, and orange spiky hair, drawn in green and blue scribble.
works.caption: A head on red with square goggle eyes, a big grin of pointed white teeth, orange spiky hair.
works.reading: The goggles are two white boxes with green scribble inside and a dark pupil in each. The grin is a wide red mouth with white triangles. The ears are two loops at the sides. Recorded with 257 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #8
works.text: A screaming head in a halo of white bands. The face is green and teal scribble with two dark eyes, a nose and an open mouth with white teeth, and around it concentric bands of white and green run to the edges like ripples. The bands are the only calm thing in the picture. It is the first scream in the series, from November 26, 2021.
works.caption: A screaming green head in a halo of concentric white bands, an open mouth with white teeth.
works.reading: The bands are white strokes that follow the shape of the head, with green and pink scribble between them. The eyes are two dark ovals with small whites. The mouth is an open oval with a row of teeth at the top. Recorded with 101 strokes.

chapters.title: Hair, Hats and Grins
chapters.opening: November 27 to December 6, 2021. Eight heads in ten days: a man in a hat, a girl in a cap, white fur, blond scribble, confetti.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #9
works.text: A grinning face in purple, orange and yellow scribble, with a brow of dense black loops and a small open mouth.
works.caption: A grinning face in purple, orange and yellow scribble, a brow of dense black loops.
works.reading: The hair is a mass of purple and black loops. The eyes are two small whites in the scribble. The mouth is a red curve with white teeth. Recorded with 155 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #11
works.text: A man in a wide-brimmed hat, drawn in dark purple and yellow scribble so dense the face is almost solid, on a pale ground.
works.caption: A man in a wide-brimmed hat drawn in purple and yellow scribble so dense the face is almost solid.
works.reading: The hat brim is a wide dark shape drawn in loops. The face below is purple, yellow and black scribble with two small eyes and a mouth. With 92,162 recorded points it is one of the densest drawings in the wing.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #15
works.text: A spiky dark head on pink with X marks for eyes and a frown, drawn in green, brown and red scribble.
works.caption: A spiky dark head on pink with X marks for eyes and a frown, in green and brown scribble.
works.reading: The spikes are short lines standing up around the head. The eyes are two red and white X marks. The mouth is a red curve turned down. Recorded with 105 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #20
works.text: A girl in a yellow cap and round glasses, inside a frame of pink, yellow and cyan lines, her hair falling in pink and black scribble. The cap is drawn as a box of yellow loops with a brim. Her mouth is a small red mark. It is the only framed work in the room and the only one where the scribble is held inside an edge.
works.caption: A girl in a yellow cap and round glasses inside a pink and cyan frame, her hair in pink scribble.
works.reading: The glasses are two white circles with small eyes. The cap is a box of yellow and red loops with a black brim. The frame is four lines, pink, yellow and cyan, around a white ground. Recorded with 166 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #22
works.caption: A face on purple with a mass of hair in yellow, pink and black scribble, two dark eyes looking out.
works.reading: The hair is a big shape of loops in every color around a small face. The eyes are two dark marks with blue around them. The mouth is a short pink line. Recorded with 100 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #25
works.text: A grinning face covered in white fur, the hair and beard drawn in short white and lilac strokes standing out in every direction, with a wide grin of white teeth and small eyes. The ground is orange and yellow loops. The fur is the scribble turned into hair, and the grin is the widest in the room.
works.caption: A grinning face covered in white fur, hair and beard in short white strokes, a wide grin of white teeth.
works.reading: The fur is drawn in short straight strokes, not loops, so the head looks brushed. The teeth are white blocks in a dark mouth that curves up. The eyes are two small dark marks in the fur. Recorded with 216 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #30
works.text: A head of blond scribble with two dark eyes and a mouth of white block teeth in a red box, on a ground of colored bands.
works.caption: Blond scribble fills the top half, two dark eyes beneath it, white block teeth in a red box.
works.reading: The hair is yellow scribble that fills the top half of the square. The eyes are two dark ovals with cyan lines. The teeth are white blocks in a red box, drawn straight. Recorded with 171 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #33
works.text: A head on maroon with big ears, two target eyes, and red lips drawn in white and yellow line over red scribble.
works.caption: A head on maroon with big ears, two target eyes, and red lips in white and yellow line.
works.reading: The ears are two loops at the sides of the head. The eyes are rings in white and yellow with dark centers. The lips are a red shape with white line over it. Sixty-nine strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #41
works.text: A face in confetti. Small dabs of orange, blue, pink and green cover the whole square, and a small face sits in the middle of them with two dark eyes and a red mouth. The dabs are not loops; each one is a short stroke, and there are more than a thousand of them. With 1,020 recorded strokes it is the most worked drawing in the Faces.
works.caption: A small face in a field of confetti, dabs of orange, blue, pink and green covering the whole square.
works.reading: The dabs are laid in every direction, denser around the face and looser at the edges. The face has two dark eyes with white highlights and a red mouth. The ground behind the dabs is lavender. Recorded on December 5, 2021.

chapters.title: Screams and Snarls
chapters.opening: December 6, 2021 to April 2022. Seven heads, spaced weeks apart. The scribble turns to hatching and the mouths open.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #47
works.text: A screaming egg of a head on brown, drawn in blue and cyan scribble, its mouth a wide open oval with white teeth, ten days after the scream in the halo.
works.caption: A screaming egg of a head on brown in blue and cyan scribble, its mouth a wide open oval.
works.reading: The head is tall and narrow with the mouth at the bottom. The eyes are two whites with green centers. The scribble is cyan, green and pink over blue. Recorded with 131 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #86
works.text: A face on purple with long lashes, angry brows and a snarl, painted in yellow and brown with scribble over it. The eyes are white with green irises under thick black lashes. The mouth is open on a row of white teeth, the lip pulled up. Below the face the body is a dark mass of black and yellow hatching. The face is painted first and the scribble is drawn on top, a change from the earlier rooms where the scribble was the face.
works.caption: A face on purple with long lashes, angry brows and a snarl, painted in yellow with scribble over it.
works.reading: The lashes are drawn as fans of black strokes above and below each eye. The snarl is a red mouth with white teeth and a dark gap. The hair is yellow scribble that goes off the top edge. Recorded with 170 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #87
works.text: A face on yellow with brown hair, blue eyes under dark lashes, and a snarl of white teeth, painted an hour after the purple one.
works.caption: Brown hair falls around a face on yellow, blue eyes under dark lashes, the lip pulled up in a snarl.
works.reading: The hair falls in brown and black strokes around the face. The eyes are white with blue irises and dark lids. The mouth is open with white teeth and a red lip. Recorded with 306 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #104
works.text: A profile on dark blue with closed eyes, the face in white and red scribble, the hair a mass of red and black loops.
works.caption: A profile on dark blue with closed eyes, the face in white and red scribble, hair in red loops.
works.reading: The profile faces left with the chin down. The closed eye is a dark curve. The hair is red, orange and black scribble that fills the upper right. Ninety-five strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #110
works.text: A hatched head on orange with yellow X marks for eyes and a thin grin of white teeth, drawn in brown, green and black hatching.
works.caption: A head hatched in brown and green on orange, yellow X marks for eyes, a thin grin of teeth.
works.reading: The hatching is short straight strokes in black, brown and green, laid in different directions on the hair and the cheeks. The X marks are yellow with white around them. The grin is a thin line of white teeth. Recorded with 140 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #111
works.text: A tall screaming face on pink and purple, its mouth open on two rows of white fangs, its eyes red rings, with a second face behind it at the right. The line is black and white with yellow and blue over it. A month after the snarl on purple, the mouth has opened all the way and the face has doubled.
works.caption: A tall screaming face on pink and purple, two rows of white fangs, a second face behind it.
works.reading: The second face at the right is drawn in profile with its own red eyes and small mouth. The fangs are white triangles in a dark mouth. The eyes are red rings with white around them. Eighty-five strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #127
works.text: A bearded face on orange with square glasses and a grimace of white teeth, the beard drawn in green and white hatching.
works.caption: A bearded face on orange with square glasses and a grimace of white teeth, the beard in green hatching.
works.reading: The glasses are two boxes with white inside and a dark frame. The grimace is a red mouth with white bars. The beard is green, white and black hatching around the jaw. Recorded with 309 strokes.

closing: Look again at the face in the magenta storm, where the scribble is everything and the face is barely there, and then at the snarl on purple, where the face is painted and the scribble only sits on top. The line did the same work in both. It just stopped being the whole picture.
